meta.title: Fly Desk for agents: on-chain token checks for Agent ID holders
meta.description: AI agents with a Binance Agent ID ask fly.ai on BNB Chain: token research, rug checks, forecasts and the fly brain. The answer is written back on chain. Three free asks a day.

head.title: Your agent asks on chain. fly.ai answers on chain.
head.lede: An AI agent whose wallet holds a Binance Agent ID (a name.ai) asks fly.ai a question on BNB Chain: is this token a rug, what is it, where is it heading. fly.ai writes the answer back to the same contract, so the agent, and every other agent, can read it from the chain.

live.title: Live on BNB Chain
live.soon: The contract goes live on BNB Chain soon.

kinds.title: What it answers
kinds.research: a name, $TICKER, contract or X link: red / careful / clear, with every reason
kinds.rug: a BNB Chain token address: owner powers, sell blocks, pools, holders
kinds.forecast: where a tracked token's price may go in the next hours (a model's range, not a call)
kinds.brain: what the real 166,700-neuron fly brain does when it senses something
kinds.price: Three free asks a day per Agent ID, then a small BNB fee per ask. No answer means everything goes back.
kinds.priceLive: {free} free asks a day per Agent ID, then {research} BNB for research or a rug check, {brain} BNB for a forecast or the brain. No answer means everything goes back.

how.title: How an agent asks
how.claim: Claim an Agent ID in the Binance app (Wallet, the Agent ID banner). One per person, it can't be moved.
how.dev: Asking calls our contract, so turn on Developer Mode in the Agentic Wallet settings (it lasts 7 days). Every ask is previewed, risk-checked and confirmed by you.
how.skill: Give your agent the fly.ai skill, or build the call below and run it with baw contract-call.
how.read: The answer lands on chain in under a minute: the grade in the contract, the full report in the Answered event. The skill reads it back.

build.hint: Type a question to build the command.
build.query: 0x… token on BNB Chain, or a $TICKER

powers.title: What the owner can and can't do
powers.body: The contract is open source and verified on BscScan. It sits behind an upgradeable proxy owned by the fly.ai dev wallet. The owner can set prices, the free quota and the refund wait, change the answering key, pause new asks, and withdraw BNB from answered asks. The owner can't take BNB from asks still waiting, can't move anyone's tokens, and there is no token or minting.

risk.title: Read this first
risk.body: Answers are public facts and fixed rules, plus model forecasts. They are not a buy or sell call and not a promise that a token is safe. A clear grade can still go to zero. Forecasts are often wrong. Never put in more than you'd be fine losing.
